title: Dvergr Charred Tower Ruins

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dvergr Charred Tower Ruins can be found in the Ashlands. These are inhabited by the Ashlands Dvergr. The Ashlands biome contains 30 Dvergr Charred Tower Ruins.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
They appear as large Grausten structures with some Dvergr wood structures element and are surrounded by Dvergr sharp stakes.
Up to five Ashlands Dvergr can inhabit a tower, with two guaranteed and three with a 75% chance to spawn each. The structure is protected by a Ward belonging to Dvergr.

sections.heading: Resources
sections.text:
Up to nine Dvergr Ashlands crates can be found, with five guaranteed and four with a 50% to spawn each. They contain Ashwood and Flametal ore.
Up to three Dvergr lanterns can be found, which also can be picked up.
An Iron Fire Pit can be found in all Dvergr Charred Tower Ruins. It can be destroyed to get one Iron pit and one Wood.
The furnishings can be destroyed for Copper scrap, Wood, Finewood and Tasty mead.
